title: Construction of a Multilayered Mesenchymal Stem Cell Sheet with a 3D Dynamic Culture System
protocol: Prepare 100 mL of 200 U/mL PLA2 solution.
Add 0.5 g of sodium deoxycholate and 2 mL of PLA2 in 198 mL of carbonate buffer solution.
Obtain the fresh porcine pericardium (FPP) from the slaughterhouse and return to the laboratory within 1 h.
Thoroughly wash the FPP with 200 mL of phosphate buffer solution (PBS) containing 1% penicillin-streptomycin in a 500 mL beaker at 10 °C for 10 min.
Repeat washing step with PBS at 10 °C for 10 min two more times.
Split the FPP into two layers and remove the adipose tissue with forceps and scissors.
Keep the FPP wet by adding 50 mL of PBS every 20 min during removal of adipose tissue.
Shape the FPP into 10 x 10 cm² pieces with scissors.
Wash the FPP with 200 mL of carbonate buffer solution (CBS) containing 1% penicillin-streptomycin in a 500 mL beaker at 10 °C for 10 min.
Repeat washing step with CBS at 10 °C for 10 min two more times.
Transfer the FPP to pure water and soak it at 10°C for 12 h.
Soak the 10 x 10 cm² samples in 50 mL of CBS containing 200 U/mL PLA2 and 0.5% (w/v) sodium deoxycholate solution at 37 °C for 6 h.
Wash the samples with CBS containing 1% penicillin-streptomycin at 10 °C for 10 min.
Repeat washing step 2 times.
Soak each sample in 50 mL of CBS containing 200 U/mL PLA2 and 0.5% (w/v) sodium deoxycholate solution at 37 °C for 2 h.
Wash the samples with CBS containing 1% penicillin-streptomycin at 10 °C for 2 h.
Repeat washing step for 10 times.
Place the samples on flat plates and dry them to constant weight in a constant temperature oven at 55 °C.
Weigh the DPP sample every 10 min until the weight no longer changes, repeat this process 3 times or more.
Shape each DPP sample into a 10.5 mm-diameter circle with a trephine.
Pack each DPP in a sterile sealed bag.
Sterilize the DPP samples by gamma irradiation (25 kGy).
Store the DPP samples at 4 °C before use.

Autoclave all instruments and tissue carrier components at 121 °C for 30 min, including 1.5 mL centrifugal tubes, forceps, toothed forceps, scissors, black bases (tissue carrier component), and white tension rings (tissue carrier component).
Weigh 2 g of sucrose and dissolve in 18 mL of ultrapure water to make 10% sucrose solution.
Autoclave the 10% sucrose solution at 121 °C for 30 min or filter with a 0.22 µm filter.
Autoclave dynamic perfusion system devices, including gas exchange equipment, a 500 mL glass bottle, a perfusion culture container, and connective tubes, at 121 °C for 30 min.
Put the black base part of the tissue carrier in a culture dish.
Pick up a dried DPP scaffold and place it in the center of the black base.
Place a white tension ring on the DPP scaffold and fix it in the tissue carrier.
Add 100 μL of culture medium to the DPP scaffold for rehydration.
Put the scaffold into a 37 °C incubator and allow soaking for 15 min.
Autoclave the instruments including forceps, toothed forceps, and scissors at 121 °C for 30 min.
Soak an animal in 75% alcohol solution for 5 min.
Incise the skin on the back of the animal with scissors and forceps.
Isolate the thigh femurs and place them in 30 mL PBS in a centrifuge tube.
Vortex the centrifuge tube to wash the tissue thoroughly, repeat this step 2 times.
Cut both ends of the femurs with scissors and expose the marrow cavity.
Aspirate 2 ml of BMSC culture medium with an injection syringe.
Insert the needle into the marrow cavity and flush out bone marrow with culture medium.
Add 2 mL of culture medium to each 100 mm culture dish.
Place the culture dish in a 37 °C incubator and statically culture for 72 hours.
Remove the culture dish from the incubator.
Replace the supernatant with 6 mL of fresh culture medium.
Observe primary BMSCs under a microscope.
Passage BMSCs every 5 to 7 days.
Take cells out of the incubator.
Observe the cells under a microscope and select suitable cells for cell sheet construction.
When BMSCs reach 80% - 90% confluence, choose them as seeded cells.
Remove culture medium from the dish.
Gently wash cells with 2 mL of warm PBS.
Remove all PBS from the dish ensuring no liquid remains.
Add 2 mL of 0.25% trypsin to the dish and incubate at 37 °C for 3 minutes.
Stop the trypsin effect by adding 2 mL of culture medium, then gently wash cells from the dish.
Transfer cell suspension into a new 15 mL centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge cells at 225 x g for 5 minutes.
Remove supernatant and resuspend cells in 3 mL of 10% (w/v) sucrose solution.
Aspirate 10 μL of the cell suspension and count cells with a hemocytometer.
Calculate volume needed for the next step based on cell count.
For one cell sheet, use three million BMSCs.
Extract three million cells and transfer them into a new 15 mL centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge the cells at 225 x g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells with 1 mL of 10% (w/v) sucrose solution.
Transfer the cell suspension into a 1.5 mL centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge the cells at 260 x g for 5 min.
Completely remove the supernatant and obtain the cell sediment.
Add 20 µL of 10% (w/v) sucrose solution to the 1.5 mL centrifugal tube.
Gently resuspend the BMSCs and obtain a uniform suspension.
Add 20 µL of RAD16-I peptide hydrogel at the top of the suspension.
Gently stir the RAD16-I peptide and cell suspension with the pipette tip.
When the cell suspension and hydrogel are mixed together, gently pipette the mixture a couple of times.
Take out the DPP scaffold from the tissue carrier and gently aspirate the culture medium with a pipette tip.
Aspirate the mixture and evenly add it to the DPP scaffold.
Add 1 mL of culture medium to the bottom of the tissue carrier.
Put the cell sheet in the 37°C incubator for 5 minutes.
Take out the cell sheet from the incubator.
Gently add 4 mL of culture medium into the culture dish and immerse the cell sheet.
Put the cell sheet back in the 37°C incubator for 2 hours of static culture.
Prepare the dynamic perfusion system, including a peristaltic pump, gas exchange equipment, a 500 mL glass bottle, a perfusion culture container, and connective tubes.
Assemble the dynamic perfusion system as shown.
Add 200 mL of culture medium to the sterile glass bottle.
Insert the cell sheet into the chamber of the culture container.
Close the container after adding 3 mL of culture medium.
Place the dynamic perfusion system in the incubator and start the pump.
Set the flow rate of the peristaltic pump at 8 mL/min.
Culture the cell sheet in the dynamic perfusion system for 48 hours.
Autoclave the instruments and tissue carrier components at 121°C for 30 minutes, including 1.5 mL centrifugal tubes, forceps, and toothed forceps.
Pull out the input duct from the glass bottle to stop the supply of culture medium to the container.
Stop the peristaltic pump when the culture container is empty.
Take out the cell sheet from the culture container and put it in a culture dish.
Use one forceps to immobilize the tissue carrier.
Use another toothed forceps to separate the white tension ring from the black base.
Obtain the multilayered BMSCs cell sheet.
Transfer each cell sheet to a 1.5 mL centrifugal tube with forceps.
Attach the DPP scaffold to the inner wall of the centrifuge tube.
Spread out the cell sheet as much as possible in the centrifuge tube.
Gently add 1 mL of culture medium into the centrifuge tube to immerse the cell sheet.
Close the cap of the centrifuge tube and store the cell sheet at 4 °C.
